I added `worklog total --week`. It only counts entries dated from this Monday through today, both days included. All 10 tests pass, including the two I added.

**What changed**
- **`lib/commands.js`**: `total` now takes a `--week` option. When it's set, entries are filtered to the range from `mondayOf(today)` to `today`, using the date helpers already in `lib/days.js`. It works together with `--project`, and the usage text now lists the new option.
- **`test/commands.test.js`**: one new test sets "today" to Wednesday 2026-11-11. It checks that last Sunday and tomorrow are left out while Monday and today are counted, both with and without `--project`. Another new test checks `mondayOf` on a weekday, on a Monday, on a Sunday, and in a week that starts in the previous month.
- **`README.md`**: added a usage example.

Running it on your real `worklog.json` today gives 8.5h for the week (acme 5h, globex 2.5h, internal 1h).

Because the range ends at today, any entry dated later this week won't be counted until that day comes.
